reader.zh-Hant: LocalChatHistory 現在支援 memory compression 與 sidecar archive。當訊息超過保留數量時，舊訊息會壓縮並寫入 `chat_history/.archive/<conversation_id>.json`。
reader.en: LocalChatHistory now supports memory compression with sidecar archive files. Older messages are compacted and archived under `chat_history/.archive/<conversation_id>.json`.
reader.ja: LocalChatHistory は memory compression と sidecar archive に対応しました。古いメッセージは圧縮され、`chat_history/.archive/<conversation_id>.json` に保存されます。

symbols.name: LocalChatHistory
symbols.summary: File-based chat history backend storing one JSON file per conversation.

init.signature: LocalChatHistory(storage_directory: str, memory_config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)

params.name: storage_directory
params.description: Directory used to persist conversation JSON files.

params.name: memory_config
params.description: Memory compression/archive policy (retain_recent_messages, archive_directory, entity limits, vector placeholder toggle).

behavior.directory_creation: Creates the storage directory with parents=True and exist_ok=True.

methods.name: conversation_exists
methods.summary: Check whether the corresponding conversation JSON file exists.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Conversation id used as file stem.

returns.description: True if the file exists, otherwise False.

methods.name: create_conversation
methods.summary: Create a new conversation file if it does not already exist.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Conversation id used as file name stem.

behavior: Does nothing if the conversation file already exists.
Initial payload contains conversation_id, messages=[], and created_at.

methods.name: add_message
methods.signature: add_message(conversation_id: str, message: Dict[str, Any]) -> None
methods.summary: Ensure the conversation exists, append a timestamped copy, then optionally compress/archive older messages.
behavior: Calls create_conversation() first to ensure base structure exists.
Loads the conversation again after creation.
Copies the input message before adding timestamp, so the caller's object is not mutated.
If memory compression is enabled and message count exceeds threshold, older messages are compacted and archived.

raises.when: conversation cannot be loaded immediately after creation

raises.when: saving the updated conversation file fails

params.name: skip
params.description: If null, returns only the latest 10 items. Otherwise skips the first N newest items and returns the rest.

behavior: Files are sorted by st_mtime descending before slicing.
Default behavior is a latest-10 view, not a full listing.

runtime_notes.content: Each conversation is stored as a standalone JSON file, which makes the backend simple to inspect manually but not optimized for high concurrency.
Calling list_conversations() without skip does not return all ids; it returns the latest 10 by file modification time.
add_message() copies the input message before injecting timestamp, so external caller state is preserved.
When message count exceeds retain_recent_messages, archived bundles are written to .archive with Level 0~3 records (raw, narrative, entities, vector placeholder).
